title: By the statues
goals: Reach the mark, where the corridor goes down.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# If Dask looks up, walk down two cells with `move_down`.

# Walk right with `move_right`.

# Walk down with `move_down`.
hints: We can check which way Dask is looking with `facing`!
If he looks up, move down 2 cells inside the `if`, with four spaces in front.
After the `if`, with no spaces in front, walk 4 cells right and 3 down.
intro: Dask is standing still between the first two statues. We are against the top wall. If he looks up, we must go down two cells and pass below him! If he looks down, we can cross straight. Then we go down into the corridor between the second and third statue, where the mark is.
outro: We passed without his seeing us! Let us see where this corridor leads.
learned: Now you know that `if` runs its lines only when its condition is true, and that what comes after it runs always.
